#list of cleaned columns

# cleaning dataset

```{r}
library(tidyverse)

x <- c(1)
movies <- read.csv("movie_data.csv")
attach(movies)
movies_clean <- movies
movies %>% map(~sum(is.na(.)))

movies_data <- read.csv("movie_data.csv")
head(movies_data)

movies_data <- drop_na(movies_data)
movies_clean <- movies_data
movies_clean %>% map(~sum(is.na(.)))

movies_clean$Run.Time <- movies$Run.Time %>% str_extract_all("\\d+") %>% map(~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  map(~.[1] * 60 + .[2]) %>% unlist()
```

```{r runtime cleanup}
movies_clean$Run.Time <- movies_data$Run.Time %>% str_extract_all("\\d+") %>% map(~as.numeric(.)) %>%
  map(~.[1] * 60 + .[2]) %>% unlist()
```

```{r imdb review cleanup}
km <- function(string){
  if(!is.na(as.numeric(string))){
    num <- as.numeric(string)
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "K")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_sub(string, 1, -2)) * 1000
  }
  if(str_detect(string, "M")){
    num <- as.numeric(str_sub(string, 1, -2)) * 1000000
  }
  num
}

movies_clean$Count.of.IMDb.Ratings <- movies_data$Count.of.IMDb.Ratings %>% 
  map_dbl(~km(.)) 
```


```{r genre cleanup}
movies_wide <- movies_data %>% select(Title, Genre) %>% 
  separate_rows(Genre, sep = ",") %>%
  mutate(present = TRUE) %>%
  pivot_wider(
    names_from = Genre,
    values_from = present,
    values_fill = FALSE,
    values_fn = any
  )

movies_clean <- movies_clean %>% inner_join(movies_wide, by = "Title")
```

```{r relsease date}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)

movies_data |> 
  separate(
    Release.Date,
    into = c("date", "country"),
    sep = "\\(", 
    fill= "right"
    ) |>
        mutate(date = str_trim(date),
                country = str_trim(sub("\\)$", "", country)),
                month = str_extract(date, "^[A-Za-z]+")
              ) |>
                relocate(month, .before = date)



```
